visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair and glasses wears a black collared shirt. He is framed in a medium close-up, centered against a vibrant, high-definition background of orange salmon roe. He speaks directly to the camera, using active hand gestures to emphasize points. Yellow and white text boxes are layered at the top, while white subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) The scene transitions to a detailed 3D molecular model graphic. Two versions of a molecule are shown, with red spheres for oxygen, black for carbon, and white for hydrogen. Technical notations and bond measurements are visible on the white graphic background. (3) The visual shifts to three stacked line graphs showing scientific data. The graphs track 'Counts' against 'Temperature (K)', featuring multiple colored lines (red, blue, green, purple). The man's face is occasionally overlaid in a smaller frame or cut back to. (4) The final phase returns to the man in the original setting. He continues speaking with an expressive face, occasionally holding a blue pen and pointing it towards the camera to punctuate his explanation. The background remains the static image of salmon roe.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 加入泛糰會員 一起撐開腦洞. [Slogan]: 用宇宙模擬器 做出不可能分子. [Subtitle]: 出現了. (2) [Subtitle]: 生命起源的一塊失落拼圖現身. (3) [Subtitle]: 科學家在實驗室打造迷你宇宙. (4) [Subtitle]: 成功創造一個不可能分子. (5) [Subtitle]: 夏威夷大學馬諾阿分校. (6) [Subtitle]: 與華東師範大學等團隊. (7) [Subtitle]: 在《自然通訊》上宣布. (8) [Subtitle]: 他們做出百年來只存在理論中的. (9) [Subtitle]: 不可能分子「甲四醇」. (10) [Subtitle]: 又稱原碳酸. (11) [Subtitle]: 顧名思義是一個碳硬接四個-OH羥基. (12) [Subtitle]: 看起來像酒精界的四面佛. (13) [Subtitle]: 但極敏感易碎. (14) [Subtitle]: 比某國政府還玻璃心. (15) [Subtitle]: 我們知道碳原子是生命的基本積木. (16) [Subtitle]: 有四隻手. (17) [Subtitle]: 能牢牢抓住四個原子或原子團. (18) [Subtitle]: 形成穩定分子. (19) [Subtitle]: 但這能力有極限. (20) [Subtitle]: 要讓它同時抓四個羥基這種黏人精. (21) [Subtitle]: 會壓力爆表立刻分解.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male narrator speaking Mandarin with crisp articulation. He is accompanied by a driving, mid-tempo electronic background track featuring synth plucks and a steady percussive beat. (2) A synthetic 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the visual shift to diagrams. The music continues without interruption, maintaining a consistent energy level. The speaker's volume is projected and authoritative, typical of professional science communication. (3) Occasional digital 'ding' or 'click' effects sync with the appearance of text on screen. The vocal delivery remains fast-paced and information-dense, with short, rhythmic pauses between sentences. (4) The master mix remains clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio, ensuring the speech is the primary focus over the rhythmic BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Background Explanation -> Experimental Detail -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the general public about a recent chemical discovery involving 'Methanetetrol'. It uses a blend of engaging storytelling (comparing a molecule to a 'fragile heart' or a 'four-faced Buddha') and scientific visual aids to explain complex chemistry concepts in an accessible way.
